finalists.label: Osteosarcoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including a large metadiaphyseal lesion of the tibia with soft-tissue opacity, bone erosion, and destruction of the tibia and adjacent fibula.

finalists.label: Bone infection
finalists.why: It is supported by findings of intermittent fevers, ulceration, and discharge, although the normal laboratory studies are a significant consideration against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a large metadiaphyseal lesion with soft-tissue opacity, bone erosion, and destruction of the tibia and adjacent fibula, as well as the patient's decision to undergo transfemoral amputation, tipped the balance in favor of Osteosarcoma.
